title.narrative: Propuesta de Intervención Multinivel para la Protección de las Poblaciones Migrantes Haitianas y Dominico-Haitianas

description.narrative: Intervention Lines 1. Advocacy: Strategic Communication and Public Narrative Objective: To counter hate speech, disinformation, and stigmatization of the migrant population through communication actions on social media and Catholic media outlets. Actions: • Production of short audiovisual content (reels, clips, testimonies, infographics) through specialized consultancies. • Dissemination on social media and Catholic radio stations with positive messages on hospitality, coexistence, and migrant rights. • Short-form research pieces debunking common migration myths and promoting factual information. • Systematization of testimonies from individuals affected by migration policies as tools for awareness and evidence. 2. Protection: Case Documentation and Community Support Objective: To strengthen community and organizational capacity to protect migrants in vulnerable situations. Actions: • Hiring of local consultants to carry out field assessments on the impact of migration policies. • Identification of critical cases (arbitrary detentions, pregnant women, undocumented children, stateless individuals). • Organization of a community volunteer plan to provide legal, psychosocial, and informational support to migrants and their descendants. • Development of community response protocols in the face of enforcement actions or emergencies. 3. Assistance: Direct Response and Service Coordination Objective: To provide concrete responses to urgent needs in healthcare, humanitarian assistance, and legal support. Actions: • Mapping of health centers and organizations that can offer services to migrants in the prioritized territories. • Creation of an assistance fund to cover: o Urgent health cases (pregnancies, childbirth, child care). o Legal/logistical support in cases of deportation or detention. • Promotion of access to services through coordination with state entities and NGOs. Cross-cutting Action: Institutional Coordination and Articulation Objective: To enhance synergy among organizations and institutions working on migration issues. Key Action: • Hiring of a strategic coordination consultancy to: o Map key stakeholders. o Create spaces for coordination and case referrals. o Build a joint agenda for response and advocacy
